tripOps.title: Trip ops
tripOps.intro: Practical family logistics for nine people and a baby. Draft only — do not treat this as a booking, a fare table, or a pinned address. Recheck rules nearer the trip.

items.label: Out
items.text: Sun Nov 15 · ITA AZ 619 · IAD 4:30pm → FCO 7:00am Mon Nov 16 · ref C3L60D (non-refundable).

items.label: Arrival
items.text: 9 people + stroller + bags — prefer a prebooked van/transfer over hunting 2–3 taxis at 7am; allow slow passport control. First morning in Rome is Mon Nov 16 (rest day).

items.label: Departure
items.text: Leave Prati ~6:30–7:00am for the 10:10am flight; baby gear packed the night before.

cards.title: Documents checklist
items: Papal General Audience: Wed Nov 18 10:00am, reservation 1113_UG_18.11/2026, 9 tickets. Collect at Bronze Door (Portone di Bronzo), Apostolic Palace, Piazza S. Pietro right colonnade — day before 8:30am–1:00pm and 3:00pm–7:00pm, or day of from 7:30am.
Colosseum timed tickets: book on ticketing.colosseo.it when the window opens (~30 days before visit); book all 9 in one session (4 adults + 5 under-18).
EHIC/GHIC or travel insurance cards if they carry them (optional — no policy numbers on this site).

cards.title: Getting around
items: Base assumption: one Prati Airbnb near Ottaviano or Lepanto (not chosen yet — no street address).
Metro for Vatican/centro with a stroller; taxis/Uber-class for late returns, rain, or the full group of 9.
Skip midday returns home for naps — short on-site rests instead.
Day tickets / contactless: confirm current ATAC / tap-to-pay rules nearer the trip. Do not treat any 2026 fare as settled here.

cards.title: Apartment rhythm
items: Grocery breakfasts at the apartment (the day’s meal pattern).
Washer/laundry mid-week if the stay has a machine (desired filter — not confirmed until a listing is chosen).
First grocery run Mon Nov 16 after check-in: Despar at Viale Giulio Cesare 193 (near Ottaviano) and/or Mercato Rionale Prati in Piazza dell’Unità — draft shops, not reservations.

cards.title: November weather
items: Cool, possible rain: pack layers, compact rain jackets, a waterproof stroller cover, and one nice outfit for the anniversary.
Indoor church time is the rain backup; gelato still happens.

cards.title: Health & baby
items: Pack: infant fever meds they already use, thermometer, outlet adapter, white-noise if they use it.
Nearest pharmacy / pediatric ER = placeholder until an Airbnb address exists.

cards.title: Money
items: Cards widely accepted; keep some cash for small churches, offerings, and markets.
Budget reminder: ~$7,000 excl. flights (stay + food + tickets + local transport). Optional one-liner tracker only — not a full spreadsheet.

anniversary.title: Anniversary night ops
anniversary.intro: Calvin and his wife go out. Sister and brother-in-law watch the kids at the Prati apartment after an early kids’ dinner. Draft only — no table is held.

context.title: Context
context.party: Party of 9: Calvin, wife, kids ages 9 / 7 / 5 / 2 / 8 months, sister + brother-in-law.
context.plan: Parents go out; sister & BIL watch the kids at the Prati apartment after the kids’ early dinner.
context.stay: Stay still open — Prati near Ottaviano / Lepanto only. No Airbnb street address on this site.
context.status: No table held yet. Book Glass (or L’Arcangelo) several weeks ahead once they choose. Do not assume open tables.

dinner.title: Dinner shortlist
dinner.subtitle: Parents only — party of 2. Nothing reserved.
dinner.bookingNote: Recommend booking Glass (or Arcangelo) several weeks ahead once they choose. Do not claim or assume open tables.

restaurants.name: Glass Hostaria
restaurants.blurb: Modern tasting-menu room, not a piazza tourist table.
restaurants.hours: Site hours: closed Mon/Tue; Wed–Sun dinner ~19:00–22:30.
restaurants.thursday: Nov 19 2026 is a Thursday → within their Wed–Sun dinner window per site hours.
restaurants.price: Tasting menu listed on their site at €135/person drinks excluded (from their menu page — recheck before booking).
restaurants.booking: Book only via their official OpenTable / TheFork links on glasshostaria.it (reservations page).
restaurants.cancel: Free cancel up to 48h before for Wed/Thu visits (72h for Fri–Sun); late cancel/no-show penalty €90/person — from their site.
restaurants.taxi: Taxi Prati → Trastevere ~15–25 min; plan leave ~18:30–18:45 for a ~19:00–19:30 seating.

restaurants.name: L’Arcangelo
restaurants.blurb: Traditional Roman, walkable from a Prati base (no Trastevere taxi).
restaurants.hours: Site hours: lunch 13:00–14:30; dinner 20:00–23:00; Saturday dinner only; closed Sunday.
restaurants.prefer: Prefer when they want Roman food + easy walk home.

kidsEvening.title: Kids’ evening plan
kidsEvening.subtitle: Sister + BIL. Quiet apartment night — no ambitious outing after parents leave.

items.label: Early kids dinner
items.text: In Prati. Existing draft: La Pratolina, Via degli Scipioni 248/250 — still draft / call ahead for a larger table. Parents may not join sit-down if getting ready.

items.label: Handoff
items.text: At the apartment ~17:30–18:30: written bedtime order for 9y / 7y / 5y / 2y / 8mo, bottles/diapers location, Wi‑Fi + door code once known, WhatsApp live location, parents’ return window (~21:30–22:30 if Glass).

items.label: Quiet evening
items.text: Apartment play, books, early lights-out — no ambitious outing after parents leave.

items.label: Backup
items.text: If kids melt down, sister/BIL order simple delivery or leftover pizza al taglio. Pharmacy notes live in Trip ops.

items.label: Emergency
items.text: Parents’ phones + EU emergency 112. Nearest 24h pharmacy TBD once Airbnb is pinned.

dayFraming.title: Day framing
dayFraming.text: Keep Thursday as a light day (already on the plan): easy morning nearby, afternoon free in Prati / along the river, then the kids’ early pizza and this evening handoff.
